chapter_tool_materials.question: 检索是否有可见光波段 NA>0.5 且带宽>100nm 的实测效率数据，以补充 P0090 (NIR) 之外的可见光实证。
chapter_tool_materials.usable_content:
现有材料中缺乏针对可见光波段（通常指400-700nm）且满足高数值孔径（NA>0.5）与宽带（带宽>100nm）条件的实测效率数据。P0072提供的可见光实证包括：基于GaN的消色差金属透镜（NA=0.106，平均效率40%，最大67%）和基于TiO2的超表面（NA=0.2，焦距误差<9%），以及多层衍射透镜（NA=0.05，平均效率42%）。这些研究的共同局限在于数值孔径较低（均≤0.2），未能覆盖NA>0.5的高性能区间。P0162展示了突破高NA与宽带矛盾的新策略（分区复用复合基底），在650-1000 nm近红外窗口实现了NA=0.9的高性能设计，但其工作波段起始于650 nm，严格意义上不属于传统可见光波段，且主要提供的是设计原理和成像分辨率验证，未直接给出该高NA器件在可见光波段的完整光谱效率实测数据。因此，目前材料仅能提供低NA下的可见光效率参考，无法直接回答高NA宽带可见光金属透镜的效率权衡问题。
GaN-based achromatic metalens (P0072) / Average focusing efficiency: 40%; Maximum efficiency: 67% / Visible wavelength range; NA = 0.106, EPD = 50 μm：GaN ML: Avg 40%, Max 67%
TiO2-based metasurface (P0072) / Focal length error < 9% / Visible range; NA = 0.2, EPD = 26.4 μm：TiO2 MS: < 9% FL error
Achromatic multilevel broadband diffractive lens (P0072) / Average efficiency: 42% / Visible light; NA = 0.05, EPD = 100 μm：Multilevel DL: Avg 42%
Zone division multiplexing achromatic flat lens (P0162) / Imaging resolution: 1.1 µm (NA=0.7); Phase dispersion compensation: 2.2π / First NIR window (650-1000 nm); NA = 0.9, Radius = 20.1 μm：ZDM Lens: Res 1.1µm, Disp 2.2π

The provided materials do not contain direct experimental focusing efficiency data for visible-band dielectric metalenses with both NA > 0.5 and bandwidth > 100 nm. 

P0162 reports an experimental achromatic flat lens operating in the visible-to-NIR range (650-1000 nm, bandwidth 350 nm) with high numerical apertures (NA = 0.9 and NA = 0.7). While this meets the NA and bandwidth criteria, the text focuses on phase dispersion engineering (using zone division multiplexing on a composite substrate) and imaging resolution (1.1 µm at NA=0.7) rather than reporting a specific focusing efficiency percentage. It contrasts its performance with conventional designs requiring unachievable phase dispersion (>13.6π), but does not provide the efficiency metric requested.

P0072 provides detailed efficiency data for Hybrid Achromatic Metalenses (HAMLs), showing average efficiencies of 61-67% and maximums up to 80%. However, these devices operate in the Near-Infrared (NIR) band (1000-1800 nm) and have lower NAs (0.06-0.27 for merged types, 0.32 for air-spaced), thus failing to meet the visible-band or high-NA criteria simultaneously.

P0018 reviews Achromatic Multilevel Diffractive Lenses (MDLs). It cites a visible-band device (410-690 nm, bandwidth 280 nm) by Peng et al. with an experimental focusing efficiency of only ~10% and a low NA of 0.04. Another entry (Meem et al.) covers 450-1000 nm but has an NA of 0.3. Neither meets the NA > 0.5 criterion.

Therefore, while P0162 demonstrates the feasibility of high-NA, broadband visible/NIR lenses via structural design, it lacks the specific efficiency measurement needed to complete the trade-off analysis for this specific parameter space. The gap remains unresolved within these sources.
P0162 (Zone division multiplexing achromatic flat lens) / Focusing efficiency not explicitly quantified as a single percentage in the provided text; however, imaging resolution of 1.1 µm is reported for NA=0.7. / Visible to NIR (650-1000 nm), NA=0.9, Radius=20.1 µm; and NA=0.7, Radius=30.0 µm：NA=0.9, R=20.1µm: Bandwidth: 650-1000 nm (350 nm); Max Phase Dispersion: 2.2π；NA=0.7, R=30.0µm: Bandwidth: 650-1000 nm (350 nm); Resolution: 1.1 µm
P0018 (Achromatic MDLs Review Summary) / Focusing Efficiency ~10% (Experiment) / ~39.6% (Simulation avg); Bandwidth: 410-690 nm / Visible (410-690 nm), NA=0.04, Diameter=8 mm：Peng et al. [190]: Efficiency: ~10% (Exp); Bandwidth: 410-690 nm (280 nm)；Meem et al. [187]: Efficiency: 12%; Bandwidth: 450-1000 nm (550 nm)
P0072 (Hybrid Achromatic Metalens - HAML) / Average Focusing Efficiency: 61%-67%; Max Efficiency: ~80%; Focal Shift: <5.4%-8.6% / NIR (1000-1800 nm), Various NAs：Merged HAML (NA=0.27): Avg Eff: 67%; Max Eff: ~80%；Merged HAML (NA=0.11): Avg Eff: 61%；Air-spaced HAML (NA=0.32): Avg Eff: 27%; Max Eff: 34%

["This study provides experimental focusing efficiency data for a visible-band dielectric metalens, reporting an average efficiency of 80.39% across a 190 nm bandwidth (460–650 nm). The authors demonstrate achromatic performance using Si3N4 nanopillars with a record aspect ratio of 43.33, achieving diffraction-limited focusing and full-color imaging. However, the numerical aperture (NA) of the demonstrated metalens is 0.155, and the integrated array operates at NA 0.046, which falls below the gap's requirement of NA > 0.5.", "This study summarizes a complete research process involving the design, simulation, fabrication, and characterization of optical metasurfaces, with a major contribution identified in visible band metalens for imaging and sensing applications."]

["The authors explain the mechanism linking NA to group delay requirements, noting that higher NA demands larger group delay ranges which are limited by the material's refractive index and achievable aspect ratio. The paper details a low-temperature (200 °C) PECVD deposition and ICP etching process compatible with CMOS integration, offering context on how fabrication constraints influence the trade-off between NA, bandwidth, and efficiency in visible-light metalenses.", "The authors describe optical metasurfaces as planar devices based on space discretization and phase reconstruction that control wavefront phase, transmission, and polarization across ultraviolet to near infrared bandwidths."]

现有材料中缺乏针对可见光波段（通常指400-700nm）且满足高数值孔径（NA>0.5）与宽带（带宽>100nm）条件的实测效率数据。P0072提供的可见光实证包括：基于GaN的消色差金属透镜（NA=0.106，平均效率40%，最大67%）和基于TiO2的超表面（NA=0.2，焦距误差<9%），以及多层衍射透镜（NA=0.05，平均效率42%）。这些研究的共同局限在于数值孔径较低（均≤0.2），未能覆盖NA>0.5的高性能区间。P0162展示了突破高NA与宽带矛盾的新策略（分区复用复合基底），在650-1000 nm近红外窗口实现了NA=0.9的高性能设计，但其工作波段起始于650 nm，严格意义上不属于传统可见光波段，且主要提供的是设计原理和成像分辨率验证，未直接给出该高NA器件在可见光波段的完整光谱效率实测数据。因此，目前材料仅能提供低NA下的可见光效率参考，无法直接回答高NA宽带可见光金属透镜的效率权衡问题。
GaN-based achromatic metalens (P0072) / Average focusing efficiency: 40%; Maximum efficiency: 67% / Visible wavelength range; NA = 0.106, EPD = 50 μm：GaN ML: Avg 40%, Max 67%
TiO2-based metasurface (P0072) / Focal length error < 9% / Visible range; NA = 0.2, EPD = 26.4 μm：TiO2 MS: < 9% FL error
Achromatic multilevel broadband diffractive lens (P0072) / Average efficiency: 42% / Visible light; NA = 0.05, EPD = 100 μm：Multilevel DL: Avg 42%
Zone division multiplexing achromatic flat lens (P0162) / Imaging resolution: 1.1 µm (NA=0.7); Phase dispersion compensation: 2.2π / First NIR window (650-1000 nm); NA = 0.9, Radius = 20.1 μm：ZDM Lens: Res 1.1µm, Disp 2.2π

在可见光波段，现有实测数据主要集中在中等数值孔径（NA）或特定材料体系，尚未发现同时满足 NA>0.5 且带宽>100nm 的高效率实测案例。具体而言：

1. **中等 NA 高效率案例**：OpenAlex:W4413113281 报道了基于 Si3N4 纳米柱的宽带金属透镜，在 460-650 nm（带宽 190 nm）范围内实现了 NA=0.155，平均聚焦效率高达 80.39%，焦距漂移小于 5%。该结果证明了在较低 NA 下实现高效率和宽带的可行性，但 NA 远低于 0.5。

2. **较高 NA 的效率瓶颈**：P0072 综述指出，可见光波段的 GaN 基消色差金属透镜（NA=0.106）平均效率仅为 40%，最大 67%；TiO2 基器件（NA=0.2）主要报告焦距误差（<9%），未提供同等条件下的高效率数据；多层衍射透镜（MDL，NA=0.05）平均效率为 42%。这些数据显示，随着 NA 增加，可见光波段的效率通常受到显著限制。

3. **高 NA 设计的局限**：P0162 提出了一种基于分区复用元原子的消色差平面透镜设计，在 650-1000 nm（近红外/可见光边缘）波段，利用 2.2π 的相位色散补偿，将传统金属透镜的最大 NA 从 0.56 提升至 0.9。然而，该研究主要聚焦于近红外窗口（650-1000 nm），且对于纯可见光波段（如 400-700 nm）是否能在保持 NA>0.5 的同时维持高效率，材料中未提供直接的实测效率数据作为支撑。P0072 中的对比也显示，即使是在可见光波段，高 NA 设计往往伴随着效率的下降或复杂的结构需求。

综上，虽然存在 NA=0.155、带宽 190nm、效率 80% 的可见光实证，但缺乏 NA>0.5 且带宽>100nm 的可见光高效率实测数据。现有的高 NA 设计多集中在近红外或需要更复杂的工艺（如 P0162 的多层基底），且在纯可见光波段的高 NA 高效率实证仍属空白。

GaN-based achromatic metalens (P0072, Ref 19) / Average focusing efficiency: 40%; Maximum efficiency: 67% / NA=0.106; EPD=50 μm; Visible wavelength range：Visible: 40%

chapter_tool_materials.question: 计算成像辅助的超透镜（EDOF）在去卷积后的信噪比（SNR）损失与光学带宽扩展的量化权衡数据。
chapter_tool_materials.usable_content:
关于计算成像辅助的扩展景深（EDOF）超透镜在去卷积后的信噪比（SNR）损失与光学带宽扩展的量化权衡，现有材料提供了部分定性描述和结构相似性指数（SSIM）的提升数据，但缺乏直接的、定量的SNR数值对比或明确的带宽-SNR权衡曲线。具体而言，P0069指出，虽然经过反卷积处理的EDOF系统在全可见光谱范围内实现了清晰成像（相比单色聚焦的单透镜），但其图像的SNR低于仅针对绿光聚焦的单透镜图像。该研究通过SSIM量化了性能提升，显示反卷积后的EDOF系统SSIM比未反卷积的基线提高了0.209，但这反映的是图像质量（清晰度/保真度）而非直接的信噪比数值。P0112提到其逆设计的EDOF超透镜保持了与传统超透镜相当的关注效率，并强调了大孔径（1 mm）带来的更高SNR潜力，但未提供去卷积后SNR损失的具体量化数据。P0001则从理论层面讨论了分辨率与SNR之间的权衡，指出宽带照明下低分辨率/高SNR图像可通过去卷积转换为高分辨率/低SNR图像，但未提供具体的实验权衡数据。因此，目前材料证实了存在SNR损失，且SSIM有所提升，但没有直接给出“带宽扩展导致的SNR具体损失值”或两者的定量函数关系。
Inverse-designed EDOF metalens (P0112) / Focusing efficiency remains high over the depth of focus; comparable to traditional metalens at design wavelength / Visible spectrum (455-625 nm), 1 mm aperture, NA~0.44：EDOF Metalens: High/Comparable (qualitative description in text)
Singlet Metalens vs EDOF Metalens + Deconvolution (P0069) / SSIM improvement after deconvolution for EDOF system compared to non-deconvolved baseline / Broadband illumination (White light)：EDOF + Deconvolution vs Singlet (no deconv): +0.209 SSIM
Singlet Metalens vs EDOF Metalens + Deconvolution (P0069) / SNR comparison between deconvolved EDOF images and in-focus green singlet images / Broadband illumination (White light)：Deconvolved EDOF: Lower SNR；In-focus Green Singlet: Higher SNR

现有研究在计算成像辅助的扩展景深（EDOF）超透镜中，明确揭示了光学带宽扩展与信噪比（SNR）/调制传递函数（MTF）之间的量化权衡关系。首先，P0112指出，为了获得宽光谱下的均匀MTF，必须在设计波长处牺牲部分MTF体积（volume under MTF curve），这构成了光学带宽与可实现的MTF之间的基本权衡。其次，P0069通过实验数据量化了去卷积处理对图像质量的影响：虽然去卷积后的EDOF系统在结构相似性指数（SSIM）上比未去卷积系统提高了0.209，显著减轻了色差，但其最终图像的SNR低于传统单片透镜在绿光下对焦清晰时的SNR。这表明计算后处理以SNR损失为代价换取了全波段聚焦能力。此外，P0165展示了端到端协同设计的潜力，其计算的MTF对比度（>30%）接近参考折射透镜（~50%），但仍存在差距，且依赖于复杂的概率扩散模型后端。不同研究间的比较显示，简单的EDOF设计（如P0069）虽能实现宽带成像，但需接受SNR下降；而更先进的逆设计或端到端设计（如P0112, P0165）试图在保持较高效率的同时优化PSF不变性，从而在去卷积后获得更好的SSIM，但仍未完全消除带宽扩展带来的性能折损。
Inverse-designed EDOF metalens (P0112) / SSIM: Higher than other EDOF lenses (log-asphere, cubic); Focusing efficiency remains high over extended depth of focus; MTF volume under curve is lower at design wavelength compared to standard metalens / Visible spectrum (455-625 nm), 1 mm aperture, NA~0.44：Inverse-designed EDOF: High SSIM (qualitatively higher than log-asphere/cubic variants)；Standard Metalens (Green): Higher MTF volume at design wavelength
EDOF Metalens System with Deconvolution (P0069) / SSIM improvement: +0.209 compared to non-deconvolved EDOF system (alpha=0); SNR: Lower than in-focus green singlet images / White light illumination, visible spectrum：Deconvolved EDOF: SSIM +0.209 vs Non-deconvolved EDOF；In-focus Green Singlet: Higher SNR than deconvolved EDOF
Broadband Meta-optic with Learned Backend (P0165) / MTF contrast: >30% in 0-70 lp/mm range; Refractive lens comparison: ~50% in same range / Visible broadband, 1 cm aperture, f/2：Meta-optic (Computed): >30% MTF contrast；Refractive Lens (Computed): ~50% MTF contrast
conditions: Visible spectrum (455-625 nm), 1 mm aperture, NA~0.44

chapter_tool_materials.question: 在可见光波段，孔径大于 1cm 的消色差超透镜的实验实测效率与 NA 的具体对应数据有哪些？
chapter_tool_materials.usable_content:
现有分组结果在波段、孔径及数据完整性上与查询设置存在不一致，无法直接提供可见光波段孔径大于 1cm 且同时包含实测效率与 NA 对应的完整数据。P0004 虽孔径 2.21 cm 且报告 NA 0.13 与平均聚焦效率>46%，但波段为 0.80-1.20 THz，非可见光。P0052 虽为可见光且报告 532 nm 聚焦效率 67% 及空气中 NA 0.98 等数据，但孔径尺寸未在提供信息中确认大于 1cm。P0165 为可见光波段且孔径 1 cm，但结果指标为 MTF 对比度≥20%，未直接报告效率数值与 NA 具体对应。各研究间缺乏组间统计检验，观察到的数值差异不代表统计显著性，亦无法据此判断效率与 NA 的正向或负向 trade-off 关系。

适用条件：本素材仅用于展示不同约束条件下（波段、孔径、指标）的独立参数记录，不适用于推导可见光大孔径超透镜的效率 -NA 定量关系；缺失的统计量不代表未进行检验，但现有信息不支持组间显著性结论。
P0004 LAPIAM (THz metalens) / NA = 0.13, 平均聚焦效率 >46% / 0.80-1.20 THz, 孔径 2.21 cm：实验平均焦距: 8.17 cm；仿真平均焦距: 7.89 cm；设计焦距: 8.00 cm；相对误差: 2.13%；消色差系数: <2.9%
P0165 可见光超表面 (EDOF + 计算重建) / f/2 平光光学系统，MTF 对比度≥20% @ 100 lp/mm / 450-650 nm, 孔径 1 cm, 视场角 30°：采样波长数: 1000 个；优化迭代次数: 1000 次；SiN 膜厚: ~800 nm；AlOx 沉积厚度: ~75 nm
P0052 c-Si 可见光金属透镜 / NA = 0.98 (空气), NA = 1.48 (浸油实测), NA = 1.73 (理论) / 可见光，532 nm 处效率 67%, 带宽 FWHM 274 nm：空气中 NA: 0.98；浸油实测 NA: 1.48；理论 NA: 1.73；532 nm 聚焦效率: 67%；带宽 FWHM: 274 nm
conditions: P0165 可见光超表面 (EDOF + 计算重建)
450-650 nm, 孔径 1 cm, 视场角 30°
P0052 c-Si 可见光金属透镜
可见光，532 nm 处效率 67%, 带宽 FWHM 274 nm
limits: 可见光波段、孔径明确>1cm、同时提供实测聚焦效率与 NA 具体数值对应的完整研究数据。P0165 需确认效率数值，P0052 需确认孔径尺寸，P0004 波段不匹配。

chapter_tool_materials.question: 在可见光波段，孔径大于 1cm 的消色差超透镜的实验实测效率与 NA 的具体对应数据有哪些？
chapter_tool_materials.usable_content:
The provided materials do not contain experimental data for visible light metalenses with apertures greater than 1 cm. The only specific quantitative data on numerical aperture (NA) and focusing efficiency for a large-aperture achromatic metalens comes from a Terahertz (THz) study (P0004). In this work, a large-aperture (diameter up to 2.21 cm) single-layer all-dielectric THz metalens (LAPIAM) was fabricated. The measured NA was 0.13. The authors note that this relatively small NA is a limitation of the phase dispersion control capability in their single-layer design, which prevents achieving both high NA and high focusing efficiency simultaneously while maintaining broadband achromatic performance. The text does not provide a specific numerical value for the focusing efficiency of this THz lens, only stating the trade-off relationship. Other papers (P0017, P0230) discuss dielectric metasurfaces for molecular fingerprinting or quadratic metalenses for large FOV imaging, but do not report NA/efficiency data for >1cm visible light achromatic lenses.
LAPIAM (Terahertz Achromatic Metalens) / NA = 0.13 / Frequency range 0.80 to 1.20 THz：Measured: 0.13
LAPIAM (Terahertz Achromatic Metalens) / Focusing Efficiency (implied low/limited by NA constraint) / Frequency range 0.80 to 1.20 THz：Measured: Not explicitly quantified as a single number in the provided text, but described as unable to achieve high efficiency simultaneously with large aperture and broadband achromatic performance due to NA limitation.

在可见光波段，目前找到的孔径大于1cm的消色差超透镜实验数据主要来自P0023。该研究制备了一个直径为1cm的RGB消色差偏振无关金属透镜（基于逆设计），在488 nm、532 nm和658 nm三个波长下的实测聚焦效率约为15%（模拟值为~24%）。其数值孔径（NA）在文中未直接给出具体数值，但根据成像结果和焦距描述，属于中等NA范围（对比P0154中1cm直径LW透镜的NA=0.45，P0023的NA可能较低或相当，需确认具体值，但材料未明确列出P0023的NA数值，仅提到是1-cm-diameter）。

其他大孔径（>1cm）超透镜的研究主要集中在非可见光波段：
1. P0004报道了直径2.21 cm的太赫兹（THz）消色差金属透镜，实测平均聚焦效率超过46%，但其NA仅为0.13，且工作波段为0.80-1.20 THz。
2. P0154展示了直径1 cm的中长波红外（LWIR）超构光学元件，NA为0.45，但未提供具体的效率数值，主要强调MTF性能。
3. P0192提供了直径2 cm的单波长（1550 nm）金属透镜作为效率基准，实测效率高达>91%，NA为0.07。这显示在非消色差（单波长）情况下，大孔径介电透镜可以实现极高效率，而引入消色差色散工程后（如P0023的RGB消色差），效率显著下降至~15%。

关于可见光波段大孔径消色差透镜的带宽、NA与效率的具体权衡曲线，现有材料缺乏多组不同NA下的定量对比数据。P0023提供了一个可见光大孔径消色差案例，但仅有一个NA点（隐含）的效率数据。P0117指出高NA广角超表面实现宽带消色差极其困难，受材料色散严格限制，但未提供可见光大孔径的具体量化权衡数据。因此，无法从现有材料中得出可见光波段孔径>1cm的消色差超透镜在不同NA下的效率对应关系的全貌，仅能确认P0023在1cm孔径下实现了~15%的RGB平均效率。
1-cm-diameter RGB-achromatic metalens (P0023) / Focusing efficiency ~15% (experimental), ~24% (simulation); Focal shift ~4.5 µm (~0.03% of focal length) / RGB wavelengths (488 nm, 532 nm, 658 nm)：Exp @ 488/532/658 nm: ~15%；Sim @ 488/532/658 nm: ~24%
Large-aperture THz achromatic metalens (P0004) / Average focusing efficiency >46%; NA = 0.13; Diameter = 2.21 cm / THz band (0.80 to 1.20 THz)：Exp Avg Eff: >46%；NA: 0.13
LWIR meta-optics (P0154) / Diameter = 1 cm; NA = 0.45 / Broadband LWIR：NA: 0.45；Diameter: 1 cm
Single-wavelength metalens (P0192) / Efficiency >91%; Diameter = 2 cm; NA = 0.07 / 1550 nm：Exp Eff: >91%；NA: 0.07；Diameter: 2 cm
limits: 需要寻找可见光波段、孔径大于1cm、且具有多个不同NA值的消色差超透镜的实验数据，以建立效率与NA的具体对应关系。当前P0023仅提供单一NA点（未明确数值）的效率数据。
chapter_tool_materials.still_missing: 需要寻找可见光波段、孔径大于1cm、且具有多个不同NA值的消色差超透镜的实验数据，以建立效率与NA的具体对应关系。当前P0023仅提供单一NA点（未明确数值）的效率数据。

chapter_tool_materials.question: 在可见光波段（400-700nm），孔径明确大于 1cm 的消色差超透镜，其实测聚焦效率与数值孔径（NA）的具体对应数据点有哪些？需要至少 2-3 个不同 NA 设计的数据以建立权衡关系。
chapter_tool_materials.usable_content:
现有数据与查询条件存在关键不一致：可见光波段（400-700nm）消色差超透镜实例中，无孔径明确大于 1cm 的数据点（最大孔径为 8mm）。因此无法基于现有材料建立厘米级孔径下的效率与数值孔径（NA）权衡关系。现有可见光波段实测数据仅反映毫米或微米级孔径情况：Si3N4 超透镜（直径 90μm）在 single metalens NA 0.155 下效率 80.39%，integrated array NA 0.046 下效率 67% ± 2%；Doskolovich 等（直径 8mm）在 NA 0.04 下效率 16.4%；Mohammad 等（直径 370μm）在 NA 0.18 下效率 22.1%；Meem 等（直径 3.145mm）在 NA 0.3 下效率 12%。不同孔径设置间的效率差异不能直接等同于 NA 导致的统计显著变化，且缺乏>1cm 样本支持大孔径趋势外推。适用条件：仅适用于毫米及微米级孔径的可见光消色差超透镜设计参考。
Si3N4 achromatic metalens (OpenAlex:W4413113281) / average focusing efficiency 80.39% / visible 460-650 nm (190 nm bandwidth)：single metalens NA 0.155: 80.39%；integrated array NA 0.046: 67% ± 2%
Si3N4 achromatic metalens array (OpenAlex:W4413113281) / metalens diameter / visible spectrum：each metalens diameter: 90 μm
Silica AMDL (P0018, ref [190]) / focusing efficiency and NA / visible 410-690 nm：NA 0.04: efficiency not specified in text；diameter: 8 mm
AMDL Mohammad et al. 2018 (P0018, ref [196]) / overall efficiency / visible 450-750 nm：NA 0.18: 22.1%；diameter: 370 μm
AMDL Meem et al. 2020 (P0018, ref [187]) / overall focusing efficiency / 450-1000 nm (visible-NIR)：NA 0.3: 12%；diameter: 3.145 mm
AMDL Doskolovich et al. 2020 (P0018, ref [186]) / average focusing efficiency / 450-620 nm：NA 0.04: 16.4% (experiment)；diameter: 8 mm
Achromatic flat lens (P0162) / NA and radius / 650-1000 nm (NIR, not visible 400-700 nm)：NA 0.7: radius 30.0 μm；NA 0.9: radius 20.1 μm

现有分组数据中，可见光波段（400-700nm）、孔径>1cm 且为消色差超透镜的实测效率与 NA 对应数据点无完全匹配项，存在波段、孔径或单/多色设置的不一致。可见光消色差但孔径<1cm 的数据中，Si3N4 achromatic metalens 显示 single metalens (NA 0.155, efficiency 80.39%) 观测值高于 integrated array (NA 0.046, efficiency 67% ± 2%)；AMDL review examples 中 Peng et al. 2018 (NA 0.04, efficiency ~10%)、Mohammad et al. 2018 (NA 0.18, efficiency 22.1%)、Meem et al. 2020 (NA 0.3, efficiency 12%) 显示效率随 NA 变化无单一单调趋势。孔径>1cm 但非可见光的 THz achromatic metalens (diameter 2.21 cm) 测得 NA 0.13，波段为 0.80-1.20 THz。高 NA 但非可见光消色差的 c-Si immersion metalens 为 532nm 单波长，front-immersion (NA 1.48, efficiency 48%) 与 TiO2 back-immersion comparison (NA 1.1, efficiency 50%) 观测值接近；Achromatic flat lens with stepwise substrate 为 650-1000nm，lens 1 (NA 0.9) 与 lens 2 (NA 0.7) 未报告效率对比。综上，可见光消色差条件下，现有小孔径数据未呈现 NA 与效率的明确统计显著权衡规律，且缺乏>1cm 孔径的可见光实测数据支持。

适用条件：仅适用于评估现有文献中不同波段与孔径限制下的 NA 与效率分布，不可直接外推至可见光>1cm 消色差场景；组间数值差异未报告统计检验结果，不代表操作造成的显著性差异。
Si3N4 achromatic metalens (OpenAlex:W4413113281) / average focusing efficiency 80.39% / visible spectrum 460-650nm (190nm bandwidth)：single metalens: NA 0.155, efficiency 80.39%；integrated array: NA 0.046, efficiency 67% ± 2%
Si3N4 achromatic metalens array (OpenAlex:W4413113281) / metalens diameter 90 μm per element / 5×5 array on CMOS chip：each metalens: diameter 90 μm；focal length: 980 μm；NA: 0.046
THz achromatic metalens (P0004) / measured NA 0.13 / 0.80-1.20 THz (NOT visible)：diameter: 2.21 cm；NA: 0.13；focal length: 8.17 cm (experiment), 7.89 cm (simulation)
Achromatic flat lens with stepwise substrate (P0162) / NA 0.9 and NA 0.7 designs / 650-1000nm bandwidth (partially visible)：lens 1: NA 0.9, radius 20.1 μm；lens 2: NA 0.7, radius 30.0 μm
AMDL review examples (P0018) / various NA and efficiency values / visible to NIR range：Peng et al. 2018: NA 0.04, diameter 8mm, efficiency ~10%；Mohammad et al. 2018: NA 0.18, diameter 370 μm, efficiency 22.1%；Meem et al. 2020: NA 0.3, diameter 3.145mm, efficiency 12%
Metasurface doublet (P0148) / simulated focusing efficiency vs NA / 1180-1680nm (NIR, NOT visible)：NA 0.42: diameter 100 μm, layer spacing 5 μm；NA 0.29: triplet design, diameter 120 μm
c-Si immersion metalens (P0052) / focusing efficiency 48% / 532nm (visible, single wavelength)：front-immersion: NA 1.48, efficiency 48%；TiO2 back-immersion comparison: NA 1.1, efficiency 50%
conditions: Achromatic flat lens with stepwise substrate (P0162)
limits: 可见光波段（400-700nm）、孔径>1cm、消色差超透镜的实测聚焦效率与 NA 对应数据点；至少 2-3 个不同 NA 设计的完整数据以建立权衡关系
